description: Fixed-seed Object10 post-integration measurement for Group 3 simulator collision, carry-sweep, and backend robustness changes. Group 2 was promoted by explicit human review despite a 1/10 formal result because the observed failures were not attributable to its XML decision transport; this run tests whether Group 3 improves those physical execution failures.

integration_invariants: main planner retains the Group 2 XML decision transport
ToolContract request, receipt, bundle, and provenance authority remain unchanged
LIBERO retains the reviewed Mink controller path
arm-versus-world collision checks use the active obstacle geometry
tentative and confirmed carried objects receive conservative swept-volume checks
gripper aperture is attachment evidence rather than proof of attachment
RobotState joint_names is an optional additive field and legacy states remain valid
base_control remains a simulator backend capability and is not added to the planner tool surface

metadata.group2_gate_decision: promoted by explicit human review; the numeric decline was accepted as likely stochastic and the observed failures were not attributed to Group 2
metadata.quality_gate: post-integration evidence review against both the 2/10 frozen baseline and the human-approved 1/10 Group 2 run; do not attribute stochastic physical outcomes to Group 3 without rollout evidence
metadata.feature_group: simulator collision restoration, carried-object sweep checks, backend robustness, and optional named-joint state
